notes: New: Choose a color theme in Settings. Pick from Indigo, Berry, Terracotta or Forest.
New: The program now has a new name, Lodger, with a new logo shown throughout.
New: Pages now sit as icons down the left side. Hover over one to see its name.
Improved: Badges on the page icons show how many requests, payments and cleanings need you.
Improved: Your business name and the New booking button now sit in a top bar.
Improved: Buttons, the calendar and the Today panel now follow your chosen theme colors.
